selection: All eleven incomplete-relation, complete-NER documents in the existing locked nineteen-document development queue, in original order. No model-score/error selection, replacement or new collection.
goal: Expand source-grounded development relation coverage without silently completing unknown pairs or changing entity definitions. Report denominators and rare-relation support, not inferred real-world reliability.
entityPolicy: Preserve all nineteen source references and all NER fields, three quarantines, five already complete relation documents and every previously resolved pair. No retractions in this revision.
positivePolicy: Use the unchanged parent's explicit operator/task or method/benchmark attribution. Named repeated mentions may be correlated. Whole-approach evaluation does not certify component evaluation.
negativePolicy: Only parent's explicit_argument_role_contrast or explicit_dataset_use_contrast with literal evidence. Absence, training-only mention, poor performance, different entity types and UNRESOLVED are not negatives.
reviewPolicy: Read whole source and fixed entity inventory, decide explicit groups, then perform actual same-session AI self-review. Inherited receipt binding is separate from a fresh generation/review chain. Empty groups mean inspection without new labels, not completed annotation.
independence: AI reference labels, not human gold or blind independent evaluation. This development queue has already been used for model selection; do not claim new holdout quality.
experiment: Development-label revision and strict encoding preflight only. Do not train, infer, inspect model errors to set labels, read reserved-test content, replace production graph/models or overwrite historical scores. New comparison needs a separately locked experiment.
